positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-proximity-assignment
positions.summary: KQED reports that Cheung supports a zone-based assignment system and names family choice and access to equitable schools as priorities.

citations.quote: Cheung believes families’ choice and access to equitable schools should be the district’s priorities. She supports a zone-based system
citations.locator: Positions on Key Issues, student-assignment question

positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-spend-reserves
positions.summary: Cheung supports keeping the legally required reserve plus a stabilization reserve, and says reserves should not keep growing while classrooms are understaffed.

citations.quote: I support maintaining the legally required reserve plus a prudent stabilization reserve based on clearly identified risks and future obligations. But reserves should not grow indefinitely while classrooms are understaffed and students go without services.
